title: The Interrogation Current

features.name: pressure pool
features.desc-on-touch: Water under interrogation, pressing up against what it holds. You feel the weight of all the drowned shelf's unanswered questions.

features.name: rising current
features.desc-on-touch: A tower of force climbing through the water, asking the shelf what it's holding. Each rise is a new question.

features.name: interrogation marks
features.desc-on-touch: Marks carved into stone by patient current. The questions never resolve; the stone just learns to hold them.

features.name: suspended witness
features.desc-on-touch: A thing held motionless in the current, caught between pressure below and pressure above. It remembers what it was asked.

features.name: stone's reply
features.desc-on-touch: Where the shelf finally answers: silence. But a silence that has learned to hold a question.

reverie.title: REVERIE — deep water, questions that don't rise
narr: You are waist-deep in dark water, asking her something
she cannot hear above the current. She turns back toward
the shelf, where stone still holds what it was asked, and
you understand: some answers drown. She reaches down and
touches the bottom—silt, time, the patience of stone.
The current takes your voice. The stone remembers it instead.

inscription: the current asks; the shelf does not answer; the stone learns the question is the only truth here

file.name: Pressure_Marks_On_Submerged_Shelf_24hrs.wav
file.note: A recording of water interrogating stone. Pitch rises where questions accumulate; pitch drops where answers dissolve back into current.

exits.label: back toward the drowned shelf, where silence still holds still
into deeper water where currents learn to ask new questions
toward the place where questions wash ashore
